name: METEOR VII VITA
author: Galetote
description: A loader that runs the native library of the Android version of FINAL FANTASY VII (v1.0.29) on the PlayStation Vita, without emulation: the original ARMv7 .so runs directly on the CPU, with the Android system calls redirected to their Vita equivalents.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
